label: a palm tree.
why: The camera looks up the trunk of a coconut palm at its whole crown, with fronds spreading in every direction against the sky; the fronds stir slightly in the wind and the camera is still. Cuts fall at 3.25 s and 5.75 s and the later shots are tight close-ups of the coconuts, so the first shot from 0 to 3 s is the only one where the whole tree crown is in frame.
